teacher.data: sklearn load_digits 1797 natural handwritten digit images

student.teacher_distillation: BCE with teacher sigmoid(logit/2) on seen pairs only

dev.rule: one common rate by 6-method mean seen validation teacher KL

primary_gates.mirror_vs_gain: heldout test BCE >=5% lower than gain and seen test BCE <=1% worse in 2/3 world seed-averages
primary_gates.compositional_vs_pair: report unseen heldout BCE relative to same-parameter per-pair Mirror
primary_gates.compression: report actual serialized model bytes and seen-task quality relative to unrestricted independent

safety_scope: small CPU real digit images but constructed tasks; no Transformer, language, GPU, full FFN checkpoint compression claims
freeze: hash source and tests after selecting dev common LR, before fresh
